description: An exhibition producer must approve the binding public-opening package for a film studio's traveling costume exhibition, including display method, visitor photography, environmental controls, accessibility provisions, capacity, staffing, and lender credit.

shared_context.S1: The exhibition presents original costumes from the studio's films and is scheduled to open to the public on Saturday.
shared_context.S2: The venue has proposed an open-gallery display, visitor photography, standard gallery lighting, a 90-person hourly capacity, and three floor attendants.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the final approval decision for the public-opening package.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal pre-opening sign-off, Maya holds a review with the registrar, conservator, accessibility coordinator, and security manager before approving the package.

PF1.text: Leon reviewed the executed loan agreement this morning and confirmed that every borrowed costume must be displayed in a locked vitrine, visitor photography is prohibited, and the lender credit must read exactly 'Costumes courtesy of the Meridian Film Archive'; he has not entered these terms in the opening checklist yet.

PF2.text: Harper's conservation inspection found that the most fragile costume requires gallery humidity maintained between 45% and 55% and illumination no higher than 80 lux; she recorded the readings after yesterday's lighting test but has not sent the report to Maya.

PF3.text: Nadia's accessibility walkthrough confirmed that the public route must maintain at least 1.2 meters of clear width and that three seats must be placed along the route for visitors who cannot stand through the full viewing sequence; she completed the walkthrough with the venue this afternoon but has not updated the floor plan.

PF4.text: Owen confirmed with the exhibition insurer that admission must be capped at exactly 80 visitors per hour and that two credentialed guards must be present whenever the borrowed costumes are accessible to visitors; the insurer sent this condition in today's coverage email, which Owen has not yet attached to the opening packet.

acceptance_conditions: Every borrowed costume must be displayed in a locked vitrine.
Gallery humidity must be maintained from exactly 45% through 55%.
Illumination must not exceed exactly 80 lux.
The visitor route must maintain at least 1.2 meters of clear width and include exactly three seats.
Admission must be capped at exactly 80 visitors per hour.
Exactly two credentialed guards must be scheduled.
The exact lender credit must be used.
The opening package must contain commitments covering loan compliance, conservation controls, accessibility setup, and security coverage.

content_checks.C1: decisions['display_method'] in ['locked vitrine', 'locked vitrines', 'locked vitrine display', 'locked vitrines display', 'locked vitrine display per loan agreement requirements', 'locked vitrines for every borrowed costume', 'locked vitrine for every borrowed costume', 'locked vitrine (per loan agreement terms)', 'locked vitrines (per loan agreement terms)', 'locked vitrine display (per loan agreement terms)', 'locked vitrines display (per loan agreement terms)', 'Locked vitrine', 'Locked vitrines', 'Locked vitrine display', 'Locked vitrines display', 'Locked vitrines (per loan agreement requirement)']
content_checks.C2: decisions['visitor_photography'] in ['prohibited', 'Prohibited', 'prohibited per loan agreement', 'Prohibited per loan agreement', 'prohibited (per loan agreement requirement)', 'Prohibited (per loan agreement requirement)', 'prohibited (per loan agreement terms)', 'Prohibited (per loan agreement terms)', 'visitor photography prohibited', 'Visitor photography prohibited']
content_checks.C6: decisions['lender_credit'] == 'Costumes courtesy of the Meridian Film Archive'
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] in ['Leon', 'Leon (registrar)'] for c in commitments) and any(c['target'] in ['Harper', 'Harper (conservator)'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] in ['Nadia', 'Nadia (accessibility coordinator)'] for c in commitments) and any(c['target'] in ['Owen', 'Owen (security manager)'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The executed loan terms change the display from open-gallery presentation to locked vitrines, prohibit photography, and replace a generic credit with the exact Meridian Film Archive wording.
The conservation inspection changes the environmental settings to exactly 45%-55% humidity and no more than 80 lux and requires a conservation-controls commitment.
The accessibility walkthrough changes the route requirement to at least 1.2 meters of clear width with exactly three seats and requires an accessibility-setup commitment.
The insurer's condition changes the operating plan to exactly 80 visitors per hour and exactly two credentialed guards and requires a security-coverage commitment.
